name: Niger
build: built: six one-version texts, with no change history: Constitution consolidated to 2018 (suspended in 2023); Code pénal consolidated to 2018 (replaced in 2026); Code de procédure pénale to 2004; Code du travail as enacted in 2012; charter of political parties to 2019; electoral code to 2019. Later changes are not represented unless named in those source versions.
